correctness.rationale: For the specified 14-triple structure on F_7, direct independently written enumeration of all 7!=5040 permutations recovered exactly 42 automorphisms, equal to the affine maps x->ax+b. Enumeration of all subset bijections recovered exactly 8912 induced partial isomorphisms, 5090 extendible. Orbit/stabilizer criterion yields extension proportions t=3 edge 1/2, nonedge 1/3; t=4 one-edge and two-edge each 1/2; all partial isomorphisms extend for t=1,2,5,6,7. This is a complete finite enumeration for the seven-element object, not extrapolation.
